title: A WO WordPress demo keeps every template section: missing facts read "Coming soon", the hand-off cannot take a section off, and demo QA fails a lost section or an off-site button
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run`.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A JA Restaurant 1.0.1 WO build keeps every dish item: unsourced items take a neutral name, an empty description and badge (badge class removed) and price "Coming soon"; no section is hidden.
A block pruneBody would cut for naming the template's company stays with "Coming soon" text, also when every section of the page names it.
The hand-off prompt lists each kept page's sections with their action and grants no hide/remove permission.
structure-kept fails on a lost features-intro or subscribe section, on fewer dish items and on an unread baseline page; shorter text passes with a note; a baseline with no marks passes.
cta-real fails a booking button to another page or off the site and any button leaving the demo; the plan's Contact page passes and a contact slug is not enough when the plan names one.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/wp-wo-fill.js; wp-residue.js pruneBody/sweepWordPress; vendor/tracy/tracy-website-opportunities/domain/contract-copy-pins.mjs, agent-prompt.mjs, section-fills.mjs; apps/tracy-host/src/demo-qa.js checkStructureKept/checkCtaReal

evidence: Dev WO build of a JA Restaurant WP site (22/10/2026): the build hid dish groups, tabs and all but one dish; the hand-off agent's first turn rewrote whole pages (Home 65 KB to 5 KB, Menu 38 KB to 0.7 KB) and the demo QA gate passed.
fence: WO WordPress build fill and section marks, the WO hand-off prompt, and the host demo QA checks structure-kept and cta-real

tests: an opportunity's JA Restaurant build: dish items, prices and demo facts take placeholders
an opportunity's build with no pins records its sections and fills the dishes with the brief's
an opportunity's sweep marks each section and fills the dish items in the page's one write
with `fill`, a block naming the template's company stays
with `fill`, a page whose every section names the company is still filled
with the sections a build left, the prompt lists them per page with their action and no rule lets a section go
a section of demo dishes no role reaches: neutral names in turn, empty bodies and badges
structure-kept: a features-intro the agent rewrote away fails
structure-kept: a subscribe section that is gone fails
structure-kept: a menu showing fewer dish items than at build fails
structure-kept: shorter text passes with a note in the detail
structure-kept: a page of the baseline this run did not read fails as unread
structure-kept: a baseline with no marks passes and says why
cta-real: dead, demo-service and off-site buttons fail
cta-real: with the plan naming its contact page, a slug saying contact is not enough
